N: Number of blocks in the chain, or of pucks along each side of the grid
f_1: Frequency of the chain's lowest mode
f_10: Frequency of the chain's highest mode, n = 10
f_n: Frequency of mode n of the chain, ω_n/2π
j: Number of the block, counted from the left wall, 1 to N
m: Mass of each block or puck
n: Number of the chain's mode, from the lowest, 1 to N
omega: Angular frequency of the one block between two walls
omega_n: Angular frequency of mode n of the chain
p: Number of half waves of the grid mode along x (across the grid), 1 to N
q: Number of half waves of the grid mode along y (up the grid), 1 to N
t: Time of N oscillations on the stopwatch
v_n: Wave speed of mode n of the chain, (22/n) f_n
x_j: Displacement of block j from its rest position
